body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Datawind, a leading provider of wireless web access products and services, unveiled the PocketSurfer3 and PocketSurfer3 Lite, its latest enhanced versions of its popular dedicated web-browsing device during CES Unveiled at CES 2010.

Both feature an improved high resolution, active matrix TFT screen that delivers lively vivid colours. The PocketSurfer3 also has a touchpad mouse pointer that greatly improves navigability around the screen.
The PocketSurfer3 retails at £199.99 and the PocketSurfer3 Lite at £149.99. Both are available from Ideal World (www.idealworld.tv) and Maplin retail stores.
